reviews.x: My boys have very long eye lashes and can not stand for water to get in there eyes so as you can imagine when we are at the beach and they are playing in the water they are constantly wiping their eyes so after years of coming home from beach trips with little red stripes on their faces from wiping the sunscreen off I found these. I use the sticks to get the spots under their eyes so that I can see when they wipe it off and need to reapply. The kids don't mind it because they think it's fun to h

reviews.t: Fun for kids, not fun for parents and 2 out of 8 broken
reviews.x: Kids wanted this for Jr Guards program as all the other participants recommended these.  2 out of 8 were broken and would not come out of the tube (same concept as chapstick/glue sticks/lipsticks). The bottom just spins and spins and the stick does not come out.  One stick was actually missing the bottom piece that makes it turn.  Color comes of on clothes and suits, but not off skin.  while it's a fun item for the kids, as a parent I would advise against it.

reviews.t: Colorful, long-lasting, and a great value for the price
reviews.x: I bought this sunblock for a circus trip to the Caribbean, and it's perfect. The colors are thick and bright, and the "chapstick" style containers make it easy to apply without getting your fingers all gross. I promised my sister that she and her kids could have the rest when I'm back from the trip, and they were extremely excited. You can make a lot of neat designs with this many colors - much more than with the old tubes of nothing but florescent colors. If you have a small makeup brus

I bought these and sent them to my daughter and her cabin mates at sleep away camp.  They enjoyed using them, but this product stained their skin, even after washing.  Last year I purchased Zinka brand, and there was no staining.

Got these in the mail last night and used them guiding a white water rafting trip today. Colors are vibrant and bright! They go on easy and stayed on well. I've read reviews that the colors rub off easily, which is true, but only if you rub it shortly after it is applied. I put some on my face and it stayed on pretty well through 6 hours on river. I just didn't touch my face for a few hours after I applied it. With all this being said, my only complaint is that the blue one broke off as soon as

reviews.t: Works great, fun colors and the color/zinc comes off easily
reviews.x: Works great, fun colors and the color/zinc comes off easily.  I bought for my husband for our boat just to have a little fun because he has a couple of spots he burned last year that now burn really easily.  Does the trick and you can see if it starts to come off so he is always protected/blocked from the sun. Will also be fun for various social events on our lake.  Last week he looked like Braveheart with the blue! :-)

So much fun! My daughters love these. We apply their "decorations" over our regular face sunscreen so I can't speak to it's sun protection. We mostly use it to make sure they aren't wiping their sunscreen off- we had a small disaster at the beach last month - sunburnt racoons eyes! I haven't had an issue with staining, even on my snow-white fair 3 year old.  I wipe off what I can then spread on a layer of CeraVe hydrating cleanser and use a soft wash cloth to get the rest off- no issue even with

I bought these thinking they would be great for my daughter.  I didn't see any reviews that made me think these would be bad as a sunblock, but my daughter was so colorful, I couldn't tell if she was red or not.  She loved being able to wear all kinds of different colors all day and enjoyed the different designs we came up with.

Worked as hoped for. Used for clown face paint for my kiddo. He sure didn’t get sunburnt that day lol. It smeared on his face just fine but wouldn’t use this for details for face painting. Getting it off was a little challenging. We used make up removing wipes and it didn’t come off completely.

I bought this for a music festival later this summer and when I tried it I didn't expect it to last as long as it did. This  is waterproof, sweat proof, and rub proof. It lasts forever and is great for long day wear. It's a lot of fun and I can't wait to use it all summer long!

reviews.t: Good stuff, works!  Just be prepared to scrub!
reviews.x: My daughter is very fair skinned so we sometimes have to go to extremes to prevent sunburn.  We used these for her face and they do work.  While it is not discrete at all, at least you can have some fun with it!  I did not experience staining as some others have, but sometimes if we put it in and didn't wear it long enough for sweat or the water to wear off, then it was very tough to get off.  To the point of scrubbing it so hard her cheeks became red and irritated.  So that would be my only con

I am from FL and have always used zinc for several reasons. When my boys were young I used to buy a similar product they sold in stores like this. Now I am in the Carolinas and have grandkids so I ordered this to see how it works. It is great. Kids love that they can decorate their face without realizing they are protecting thier skin. Colors are bright and stay on for a while even while in the water. I am ordering again.  Best thing is zinc is a natural mineral and not full of chemicals.

Nice colors but they do not stay put. I bought this for my children to have extra protection on their nose and under their eyes as that is where they tend to burn. Though this would be a nice and thick for added protection. They are not as thick as you would hope and one forgotten touch and it is a smeared mess.  It is also really hard to remove.  I found that you  need an oil based substance to remove it and not have to scrub.

Bold, bright colors are EXTREMELY waterproof (to the point of needing some major scrubbing after time in the pool), and easy to apply.  For once, my children didn't get annoyed at me sunscreening up their face.  The green is a perfect match to the Hulk, so it was a big hit.  Protected well too, kids were in the pool for over an hour. Just as a suggestion,  Zalan, come up with some glittery colors too!

I really like the idea of having all colors of zinc for eye black for football games. The white is not thick like it should be. Kinda transparent. The other two colors I have used so far are black and green. Those went on well and not see thru. Comes off very easily with water when ready to remove. Too soon to say if I would recommend to others.

reviews.t: AWESOME! I use them in place of lipstick
reviews.x: AWESOME!I use them in place of lipstick. Cheaper and stay on really well!
Worked well in our carribean cruise. Fun for kids to use!

These are a great value for the cost. In addition there easy to apply and the colors are good. The only challenges when the kids are playing sports they get sweaty and the color on their face ends up all over their arms are clothe then which makes it effective for any type of sunblock.  The variety of color is great. But I would certainly recommend using it with sunscreen.

reviews.t: It is going to be great for spirit days during the school year too (and ...
reviews.x: I wish they had a pencil version of these too.  My son loves getting face painted - so after he puts sunscreen on (he is 10 - he was never enthusiastic about sunscreen) - I use these and the zinka tubes to facepaint something for camp (really simple on one cheek).  It is going to be great for spirit days during the school year too (and football games for my older kids)

I purchased this pack for my daughter in the beginning of the summer for her and her friends to use as Junior Lifeguards.  She is also part of a swim team, and sunblock and skin care is very important! The different colors make using this a lot of fun for everyone, and it's a relief for those of us concerned about skin damage from the sun.  Fun product!

We got these for "war paint" at our summer camp and gave every team a color. The colors showed up very well, but they did stain the faces... some parents requested no face paint on day 2 and moving forward. But that's part of camp and some people do not prefer that anyways. It went on very smoothly and stayed put through all the sweat! Good product.

Lasts but you can still wash it off. We used it for a party where we were face-painting, and then we use them for the beach. Our kids look crazy, but at least they are wearing sunscreen. It becomes quite the thing to bust these out, let the kids paint their own faces.

reviews.t: fantastic. but one broke during shipping
reviews.x: Love these! I purchased one set, tried them out while surfing, and they worked phenomenally!! This second set is great too, but the white when opened broke in the middle :( probably during shipping, but i still love the product.

reviews.t: Great "war paint" sunblock for Swim &Water Polo teams
reviews.x: Quick,  easy and fun bonding.  We like Zinka too, but appreciated the variety of colors and that it was quicker,  easier and less messy. We applied multiple times (10+) on 15 team mates with plenty to spare.
These are the best colored zinc sticks I've found. It does help to let them dry a bit before swimming, but even on top of other sunscreen they held up pretty well. Great bright colors.

claims.text: Kids love the fun, colorful format, and it makes applying sunscreen easier for parents.
The colors are vibrant and provide good sun protection.
Some users report the product smears or rubs off easily and can be hard to remove.
A few units arrived broken or defective, with the stick not coming out of the tube.
Some users report staining skin or difficulty washing it off completely.
